active_laws.blueprint_revisioning: Every build change must increment its Blueprint revision. No silent changes.
active_laws.canonical_funnel_routing: Every new funnel run must go through the canonical funnel first. Results feed back through canonical funnel before push or claiming working results.
active_laws.evidence_precedence: NO CLAIM MAY HAVE HIGHER STATUS THAN STRONGEST INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE. Runtime evidence outranks comments and source plausibility.
active_laws.owner_visible_path_testing: Test the exact owner-visible path before claiming success. A file in the workspace is not 'in the app.'
active_laws.render_queue_head_rules: Before any Pulse push: check repo HEAD. If HEAD moved, download current and apply surgically. Post-push: verify live bytes via MD5 with cache-buster. Never claim live without byte match.

anti_patterns: Using count-based scoring instead of quality-weighted
Embedding full Page 0 text instead of hash reference
Claiming live without MD5 byte verification
Letting toolbox decide what user wants
bad_box.content_addressing_expectation: All Bad Box entries content-addressed by SHA-256 of (what + why). Enables family detection across failures.
do_not_rules: Do not mutate raw data after ingestion
Do not use relative paths in any funnel code
Do not let predictions mint authority
Do not let accumulated machinery override fresh Page 0

processed_data.reproducibility_rule: Must be regenerable from raw + recorded transform. Store transform hash alongside output.

raw_dogfood.ingestion_pattern: Write once. Never modify. New version = new hash.

registry_scoring.formula: +1 term match, +2 tag/provides match, +5 verified, +min(reuse_count,10) x 0.5
registry_scoring.reproducibility: Same inputs must produce same scores. No hidden state.

stable_paths.mount_stability: Mount point must survive reboots. Use permanent assignment (Windows: fixed drive letter via Disk Management; Linux: /etc/fstab entry).
stable_paths.no_drift: No relative paths. No environment-dependent resolution.

versioning.rule: Blueprint revisions increment on every change. Never rewrite history.

expedition_wiring.distillers: seedIntentDistillers() — 6 Page 0 signals detected procedurally. Weights capped at min(count/10, 3).
expedition_wiring.evidence_pool_hashing: SHA-256 content-addressed. Key format: {page0_hash_16}:{dimension}. Pre-work pool check before investigating.
expedition_wiring.tournament_scoring: quality = proven_evidence x 10 + total_evidence x 2 - unresolved x 5. Position-independent.

for: Copilot SSD mount strategy and PulseData hierarchy design

manifest_expectations.active_investigative_logic: 26 dimensions, all with real regex/text-analysis branches

ssd_mount_guidance.reboot_stability: REQUIRED. Test by rebooting and verifying paths resolve.
ssd_mount_guidance.windows: Fixed drive letter via Disk Management (e.g. D:). Path: D:/PulseData/
